Hello everyone, a quick note about job requisitions before the planning cycle starts. Every week I receive requisitions with a title, a salary range and the word urgent, and nothing else. That is not enough for the committee, and honestly, it is not enough for us. Before you send me a requisition, please talk to the hiring manager. I want three answers on every form. First, the business need: what is driving this request, in one or two sentences. Second, the workload: what the person does every week, and how much of that work is new. Third, time: is the need permanent, or is it only in the short term? If it is only in the short term, let's look into a temporary solution first. Thank you, and send me your questions.

Hi Camila, it's Diego, from collections. I'm sending you a job requisition today, and I know you are going to ask me questions, so here is some background. I know about the freeze, so this is for April. My team has six analysts, and the workload grows every month, because the dealers pay later and later. Nobody is leaving, so this is not a replacement. I need a new position, a second senior analyst, for the difficult cases. In the short term, two people from the team cover part of it, but then they stop doing their own work, and our reports arrive late. I filled in the form with the title and the salary range, but the job description is not ready yet. Can we talk tomorrow morning? Thanks.
